Amethyst 1.21 can run NApplets and WebXDC apps inside notes, adds a Web of Trust setup card, and broadens Home with listening and game formats.

The release also narrows embedded-app permissions after a security review: private-event reads need a decrypt grant, frames get no cookies or WebRTC, and signed events are verified before apps see them.

This is a released client update, not a new launch or evidence of an exploited incident.
